description:
🌟 UNITED WE TRIBE 🌟
🔥 CACAO CEREMONY · ECSTATIC DANCE · LIVE MUSIC · OPEN STAGE 🔥

Join this special gathering to remember, release and celebrate — a journey to open our hearts with cacao, songs and shared practices of reflection, compassion, gratitude.
Movement becomes prayer and our Ecstatic Dance a wild offering to life.
We nourish the body, ground with live music and open the stage for you to share your gifts, your flavour, your medicine.

🗓 PROGRAM
13:00 — Doors Open
14:00 — Cacao Ceremony
17:00 — Ecstatic Dance
19:30 — Food Nourishment
20:30 — Live Music
21:30 — Open Stage
00:00 — Chill & Goodbyes

📅 Saturday, 7 March 2026
📍 Essencia, Algarve
📍 https://maps.app.goo.gl/AvBaoYS49tXjujWVA
